LESSON: ROUNDS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Performing and Display
Topic 2.1: Rounds
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Rounds, part of Performing and Display in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How are rounds sung?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Rounds together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner keeps to own part in a round performance.

• Unity: The learner cooperates with others in groups while singing own part in round songs.

27

• Respect: The learner portrays positive regard for self and others as they work in groups on rounds.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Personal hygiene: The learner observes safety and hygiene while improvising paints for painting simple illustrations and

making props

• Self-awareness and self-esteem: The learner sings round songs with appropriate body movements in groups.

• Social cohesion: The learner takes own part while singing round songs in groups.

Link to other subjects:

• English: The learner applies the skill of communication acquired in English to clearly pronounce the words of the round.

• Religious Activities: The learner applies values such as unity and love acquired in Religious Education during group work.

Suggested learning resources

Open space, resource persons, audio /visual recordings of rounds, flash cards, digital devices, musical instruments, relevant

props and costumes, reference books, relevant virtual sites, hearing aids
